ACCEPT — independent exact-byte re-review of the V12 historical correction.

Reviewed NARRATIVE_PROCESS_ALIGNMENT_NOTES.md at SHA-256 afa2148bcfced6910bb72d99e30a8ff72192377e49b6067506ed0410651afe45 and the unchanged docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md at SHA-256 30079dd0262a6420be8c835ec99d42dc94277819680b77b6aabc66b702711f25. Exactly those two paths differ from the isolated base and git diff --check is clean.

Section 123 now faithfully preserves the contemporaneous V9 unchecked-until-receipt-join rule. Its adjacent supersession sentence correctly delegates the later orthogonal model to sections 124–126: an actually passed, receipted schema/content/identity check retains its check state; observation authority remains Draft through D1; only separately authorized E0 may promote it through the admitted issuance join. The normative plan is unchanged. I find no remaining backward historical projection, scientific conflation, constructibility defect, or identity defect.

Scope ceiling: content review only. The bytes remain isolated and uncommitted; this is not a commit, candidate review, landing or runtime authorization, and it does not cure the V11/non-rewriting governance hold.
